title: Born without sight. Scored over 93% anyway.
youtubeTitle: Born without sight. Scored over 93% anyway.
caption:
Born without sight. Scored over 93% anyway.

Isha Jain, a 15-year-old student at Kalyani School in Pune, was born blind. With support from a writer and a resource teacher, she scored over 93% - 93.2% precisely - in her CBSE Class 10 board exams in 2025, including 95% in English.
